scope.summary: Build the BodyKit face and performance workspace for identity/expression, FACS/ARKit/visemes, eyes/jaw/tongue, correctives, takes, timeline and curves.
acceptance_criteria: Identity versus expression, symmetry/asymmetry, rig/control mapping, confidence/findings, source/edit layers, dope sheet, curve editor, exact values/tangents, retime/bake and synchronized viewport/timeline/Problems selection are explicit.

Inputs, outputs, schemas, units, version/hash identities, capability state, authority/artifact ownership, privacy scope, diagnostics, cancellation/retry and unsupported behavior are explicit; a no-context implementer must not infer a provider, download, path, threshold or fallback.

Automated proof covers a successful offline Rust path plus missing/corrupt/stale/incompatible input, cancellation or adapter-removal as applicable; it verifies EventLedger/ArtifactStore/Flight Recorder consistency, no partial mutation, no hidden network/Python process and reproducible receipts.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without build the bodykit face and performance workspace for identity/expression, facs/arkit/visemes, eyes/jaw/tongue, correctives, takes, timeline and curves., BodyKit-v2 could ship an ambiguous, non-reproducible or non-professional production path.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Professional Tailor workspaces and tools

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.
Use PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS and ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; UI filtering is never the security boundary.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: Without build the bodykit face and performance workspace for identity/expression, facs/arkit/visemes, eyes/jaw/tongue, correctives, takes, timeline and curves., BodyKit-v2 could ship an ambiguous, non-reproducible or non-professional production path.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.
